headline: NSE seeks clarification from ITDC over sudden trading volume surge
hook: Unusual trading activity triggers exchange inquiry
summary: The National Stock Exchange has asked India Tourism Development Corporation Limited to explain a sudden, significant increase in its trading volume. The exchange sought this clarification to ensure investors have timely and relevant information to safeguard their interests. ITDC has submitted its response to the exchange regarding the spurt in volume. Retail investors holding the stock should monitor official disclosures for any price-sensitive announcements.
whats_next: ITDC response publication on exchange website
why_it_matters: Watch for exchange disclosures before trading volatile shares
